push.title: W 3-0 vs SharkRealm | You: 9.3 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, your best match performance of the season: a 9.3. Fresh-baked-pie good.

THE GOOD
+ Man of the Match, your 12th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ Feeding PhogsToffees like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ 9.3: your best match performance of the season. Remember how that felt.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. Mark my words: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- Most misplaced passes on the team: 8 (best was PhogsToffees's 3). One more thing: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- 2 tackles won: -0.1. That's your quickest improvement.
- Key passes: 1. Average-plus; top forwards are at 2+.

Work on: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

One thought for the road, buddskees: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs SharkRealm | You: 9.2 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, I've coached a lot of games, and a 9.2 like that one still gives me goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at SharkRealm's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ A 9.2 ranks as your best match performance of the season. That's who you are on a good day.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 0. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ 4th straight match at 80% pass accuracy. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Small change, big gain: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide. You'll thank me later.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Bread and butter: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was buddskees's 32). Real talk: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 2 tackles won cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.

This week's homework: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

Bring that energy back next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs SharkRealm | You: 9.0 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.0 against SharkRealm, BellyTb1. Your 2nd best match performance of the season, and it felt like it.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at SharkRealm's goal. Their defense never got a moment of peace.
+ 1 key pass. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ That partnership with PhogsToffees is starting to feel like a habit.
+ 9.0 goes down as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Somebody write that down.
+ A promotion match, and we won it. Enjoy it. Then go get the next one.

THE BAD
- 73% passing (16 of 22). Game plan: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble. Simple as Sunday.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 9.0 (best was buddskees's 9.3). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- Lowest tackles won on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 2). Here's the deal: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- Shots on target: 67%. 90%+ is the gold standard for a forward.

Muscle memory: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.

BellyTb1, take this with you: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

You made my night. Thank you. - Coach Lasso
